units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61a:14">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>בתחלה עלה במ׳ וכ׳</he> it was the original plan to create &c.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:13">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שעושה פרי</he> an intention which bears fruit (is carried out).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ טובה מצרפה וכ׳</he> the merit of a good intention does the Lord (in rewarding) add to that of a good deed; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:51">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> top; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:9">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ מועלת וכ׳</he> trouble (about sustenance) affects the memory even for the words of the Law (makes one forget one’s learning).—Pl. <he>מַחֲשָׁבוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:9">Ib. 26ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 11:3">Ps. XI, 3</cite>) <he>אילו מַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו וכ׳</he> if this wicked man’s plans be not frustrated, what will the righteous man do?
